headline: US stocks edge further from their records as oil prices keep swinging
summary: US stocks slipped further from record highs as oil prices swung on uncertainty over when the war with Iran would allow crude to flow freely. Brent briefly rose above $90 a barrel.
why: The Dow Jones Industrial Average and Nasdaq Composite track large US stocks and technology shares. Brent is the global benchmark for crude oil, and disruptions to Middle East supply feed through to energy costs and inflation.

impacts.name: Dow Jones Industrial Average
impacts.why: US stocks slipped from records as the Dow dipped 0.3% and the Nasdaq sank 0.6%.
